chordInfo.name: Dominant Ninth Chords
chordInfo.subtitle: Master the rich, colorful sound of dominant ninth chords - the essential voicing for funk, jazz, R&B, and soul guitar that adds the 9th to create irresistible groove.

fundamentals.label: Definition
fundamentals.value: Five-note chord: dominant 7th plus a major 9th

fundamentals.label: Key Difference from Add9
fundamentals.value: Includes the b7 (dominant 7th) - add9 chords do not

applications.label: Blues
applications.value: Jazzy extensions of standard blues changes

boxes.title: 9th vs Add9 Comparison
items: The b7 gives 9th chords their funky edge

boxes.title: Practical Voicing
items: Guitar often omits the 5th in 9th voicings
Funk-style: partial voicings on middle strings

voicingGroups.title: Essential Dominant 9th Voicings
voicingGroups.tipDescription: These voicings are the foundation of funk and R&B guitar. Practice clean, muted strumming.

voicingGroups.title: Moveable 9th Chord Forms
voicingGroups.tipDescription: These moveable shapes let you play 9th chords anywhere on the neck for instant funk flavor.

items.title: Funk Vamp I9
items.description: Single-chord funk groove that James Brown and Nile Rodgers built careers on - the 9th chord IS funk guitar

items.title: Jazz Blues I9-IV9-V9
items.description: Upgrade standard 12-bar blues to jazz blues by replacing dominant 7ths with 9th chords for richer harmony

items.title: R&B Smooth Groove ii-V-I
items.description: The smooth neo-soul sound of D'Angelo and Erykah Badu - 9th chords make ii-V-I progressions silky and warm

items.title: Hendrix-Style V9-IV9-I
items.description: Jimi Hendrix frequently used 9th voicings in blues-rock context, blending jazz sophistication with raw rock energy

techniqueItems: Practice clean muting between chord strikes
Keep fretting hand pressure light for muted scratches
Work on rhythmic accuracy with a metronome
applicationItems: Foundation of all funk guitar rhythm
Essential for R&B and neo-soul texture
Perfect for adding color to jazz comping

practiceExercises.title: Practice Exercises
practiceExercises.tipDescription: These exercises develop the rhythmic precision and muting technique essential for 9th chord mastery.

exercises.title: Exercise 1: Single-Chord Funk Groove
exercises.detail: Focus on muting technique - alternate between sounding the chord and muted scratches
exercises.tip: Start at 80 BPM, work up to 120 BPM with clean mutes

exercises.title: Exercise 2: 9th Chord Blues
exercises.detail: Replace standard blues changes with 9th voicings for jazz-blues feel
exercises.tip: Practice in shuffle and straight-8th feels

exercises.title: Exercise 3: Moveable 9th Forms
exercises.content: Play I9-IV9-V9 in keys of E, A, D, and G
exercises.detail: Use the same moveable shape, sliding to different positions
exercises.tip: Maintain consistent strumming pattern as you move shapes

concepts.title: 9th Chord Variations
items: 7b9: Flat 9 for dark jazz and flamenco flavor
Minor 9th: m7 + 9th for smooth jazz texture

concepts.title: Funk Rhythm Mastery
items: Ghost strums: Muted scratches between chord hits
String muting: Left-hand lift creates percussive effect
Wah pedal: Classic funk combination with 9th chords
Chord stabs: Short, punchy hits for horn-section feel
